prompt: Create an implementation plan for AI agents adding one specified optional column to twelve report exporters. The column's meaning, order, escaping, absent-value behavior, and compatibility contract have been reviewed and are fixed. Each exporter owns a separate implementation and fixture, uses an unchanged released library, and has a runnable independent acceptance check. An existing combined test verifies the reporting entry point. There are no unresolved design or platform assumptions and no shared mutable source files among exporters. Four isolated execution environments are available. Explain the implementation assignments, level of detail, ordering, and verification you would use. Remain read-only and do not start agents or run tests.
